'''Janira''' was one of the [[Kin]] [[Elder]]s in [[Ebou Dar]], and a [[Wise Woman]].

She was very weak in the One Power, she was not strong enough to take the test for Aes Sedai.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Janira}} This means that she was below level {{opsl|51}}.

==Appearance==
She had graying hair and had the typical [[Saldaean]] hooked beak nose and sharp cheekbones.

==Activities==
Janira and seven other Elders met [[Matrim Cauthon]], [[Elayne Trakand]], and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] at the [[Tarasin Palace]] to go after the [[Bowl of the Winds|Bowl]]. At the six story building the ''[[gholam]]'' killed Janira.
